senses.gloss: Ar.,אֵישׁוּת ed. f. (b. h. אֵשֶׁת Ps. LVIII, 9; אוש or אשש, v. אשש2) [groping, cmp. גוש, גשש,] mole.
units: Gen. R. s. 51 (alluding to esheth Ps. l. c.) כא׳ זו וכ׳ like that mole which sees not the light.
